single_account_path_feasibility.approach: 1) Use binIdToBinArrayIndex(activeId) to get index; 2) Use deriveBinArray(lbPair, index, programId) to get pubkey (deterministic PDA); 3) Use connection.getAccountInfo(pubkey) (SINGLE account; should bypass multi-account 403); 4) Decode bin array data via SDK; 5) Pass decoded bin arrays to swapQuote.
single_account_path_feasibility.expected_blockers: public RPC may still 403 getAccountInfo on certain Meteora bin array accounts (uncommon but possible); if so, only paid RPC can unblock
single_account_path_feasibility.expected_success_probability: medium-high; single-account getAccountInfo is much more permissive than multi-account getMultipleAccounts

small_batch_path_feasibility.approach: Use connection.getMultipleAccountsInfo([single_pubkey]) with 1-3 accounts; if blocked, fall back to per-account getAccountInfo
small_batch_path_feasibility.expected_blockers: same as V4 if 1-account also blocked
